Ui.Script: -- Deviation: re-runs UIParent_ManageFramePositions after DurabilityFrame's own OnEvent. The -- pass seats the frame 20 further in while a side glyph shows (UIParent.lua:1759-1768), -- but the stock frame runs it only from OnShow/OnHide, so a glyph appearing while the frame -- is shown leaves the shield's overhang off the screen edge. The stock handler runs first, -- unchanged, on the arguments the dispatch passed. if DurabilityFrame then local refOnEvent = DurabilityFrame:GetScript("OnEvent") DurabilityFrame:SetScript("OnEvent", function(self, ...) if refOnEvent then refOnEvent(self, ...) end UIParent_ManageFramePositions() end) end
